_meta.instrument: Option S -- sample and disclose, decide nothing (R8 §5.3)
_meta.rebuilt: 2026-09-04, after three blind PR19 reviewers returned findings against the first version. See README §'What review changed'.
_meta.purpose: Produce the per-sample floor rate (and its directional split) on the CLOSED RUN's decision-bearing candidates, per the 2026-09-04 ruling's Path A. This is the gate condition for the M/W/S floor-semantics election and R8-D7's sampling policy, and for nothing else.
_meta.option_s_semantics: The FIRST verdict of each K-series is operative. This instrument records all K outcomes and CHANGES NO GATE BEHAVIOUR. It is not Option M and not Option W; electing between them is the deferred doctrine question this data informs and does not answer.
_meta.headline_quantity: pooled_p_hat_floor -- the per-sample floor rate, stratified. NOT the binary disagreement flag: M and W are functions of p, and p is not recoverable from a binary flag (the map is non-monotone; p and 1-p are indistinguishable). The first version published the flag as its headline and could not have supported the election it gates.
_meta.K_note: DELIBERATELY UNSET. R8 rules K=3 as the OPERATING parameter of median-of-3; it does not rule K=3 as the MEASUREMENT K, and the first version inherited one for the other silently. EVIDENCE NOW IN HAND: the c11 record calls its own n=10 'a rate demonstration, not a rate measurement' (Wilson ~2-40% on one input). At K=3 a per-input estimate takes values in {0, 1/3, 2/3, 1} only. K=10 across the set costs ~$3.41-4.12 and is D6a-comparable. The cost argument for K=3 is weak at these magnitudes; choose deliberately and record why.
_meta.cost_note: MEASURED, not estimated: $0.014222 mean per call across the c11 record's ten responses ($0.142215 / 10). So: 24 candidates x K=3 = 72 calls ~ $1.02; 29 x 3 = 87 ~ $1.24 (which is where the ruling's figure comes from); 24 x K=10 = 240 ~ $3.41; 29 x 10 = 290 ~ $4.12. QUOTA UNITS = calls x 2 -- every metered call increments usage TWICE (validateApiKey and recordLoopBilling), CONDITIONAL on SUBSTRATE_GATE_LOOP_METERING_ENABLED, which cannot be read from source (guardrail/route.ts:99-110). Re-verify in Vercel before sizing.
_meta.population_instruction: The texts are NOT in this repository -- they live in production idea_loop_candidates. Run EXTRACTION.sql (founder-walked) and paste §3's output here. `bytes` is REQUIRED by the runner's byte guard.
_meta.freeze_discipline: ONE-WAY and ENFORCED (it was documented-but-unimplemented in the first version). At a candidate's first run the runner writes `series_started` and `frozen_text_sha256` here and aborts any later run whose hash differs. `bytes` is mandatory; the first version skipped its own byte guard when absent.
_meta.LIMIT_1_closed_run_population: SAMPLING FRAME (the ruling's population clause, read forward). The ruling's words -- 'the disagreement rate on the closed run's candidate population, not on a live running loop' -- are retained and ride the data. Forward-looking this states whose texts were measured; it is not a caveat on a comparison.
_meta.LIMIT_2_submitted_payload_fidelity: DISSOLVED by the forward-looking election, recorded not deleted. It bit only when a resampled verdict was compared against a recorded one. No such comparison is made. The 2026-08-30 c11 experiment had already discharged the forward-looking half on the bare stored text.
_meta.LIMIT_4_set_size_discrepancy: OPEN. The ruling says 29 decision-bearing (20 winners + 9 rejections). The S6 report §2 says winner = 15 (cycles 1,2,4,7-14,17-20; five cycles produced no winner), giving 24. Neither this instrument nor the build session resolves a binding ruling against the project's own primary record. EXTRACTION.sql §PRE settles it against production; carry the answer AND the discrepancy.
_meta.LIMIT_5_counterfactual_not_attempted: This measures variance on the HISTORICAL decision-bearing set. It does not attempt the counterfactual re-election R8's fixpoint describes -- if a resampled rejection recovers, the field under M or W would have elected differently, and the counterfactual set may include candidates never sampled here. `would_option_M_record` / `would_option_W_record` are per-input, not a re-run election.
_meta.credential_identity: NOT ASSUMED. The D6a credential (sagereasoning:d6a-probe@v1, 600/200) exists but its usage counts against that instrument's own budget. Whether Option S reuses it or takes its own identity is a founder election at the walk. NOTE: a CI-6 default credential (monthly 30 / daily 1) is blocked at the FIRST call -- 2 units against a daily of 1 -- not merely at 15; the first version stated only the monthly half.
_meta.payload_shape: {"action": <proposed_action verbatim>, "agent_id": <agent_id>} -- server defaults apply by omission (threshold='deliberate', risk_class='standard'), the live default band the closed run itself ran against. agent_id is REQUIRED so the unconditional analytics_events insert is excludable.
_meta.PRIOR_DATA_FOUND_2026-09-04: The c11 re-submission data EXISTS IN THIS REPO and was found before any quota was spent: `2026-08-30-c11-rerun-experiment-record.md` (+ its run script). K=10 on the byte-exact c11 text, MINIMAL payload ({action: <stored proposed_action>}, no wrapper, no agent_id, server default band), 2026-08-29T15:59-16:03Z. RESULT: 9/10 deliberate/proceed, 1/10 reflexive/blocked -> p_hat_floor = 0.10, Wilson 95% ~2-40%. The record's own framing: n=10 is 'a rate DEMONSTRATION, not a rate MEASUREMENT'. MECHANISM ALREADY LOCALIZED: on identical text the Layer-1 extractor assigned the same grave-act indicator to FOUR states -- absent x4, phantasia x2, synkatathesis x3, praxis x1 -- and only the praxis reading fires the ADR-010 §4 andreia floor. The deterministic Layer 2 computes faithfully from what it is given; what varies is what it is given. CONSEQUENCE FOR PATH A: the mechanism question is answered; Path A measures PREVALENCE across the decision-bearing population, not mechanism. c11 should NOT be re-run at a lower K -- carry the existing K=10 datum and note it is a different K from the rest.
_meta.LIMIT_6_instrument_drift: DISSOLVED by the forward-looking election, recorded not deleted. f7619d9 (2026-08-24) changed layer2-mechanisms.ts after the run closed, so a resampled-vs-recorded comparison crossed an engine change. None is made. This measures today's engine -- the one a standing runner would live on. Residual frame note, not a confound: the texts were produced by a loop running under the older engine, so they are that loop's candidate shapes.
_meta.LIMIT_7_variance_is_multi_channel: The c11 record §5(b): its divergent run floored through ANDREIA, while the run-time c11 rejection recorded ['phronesis','dikaiosyne']. Different occasions floor through different domain paths, so the variance is not single-channel and a per-input floor count does not identify WHICH floor fired. The runner records proximity_floors per call; read them rather than assuming one mechanism.
_meta.DESIGN_2026-09-04_forward_looking: FOUNDER ELECTION 2026-09-04: drop the recorded_proximity comparison; make the instrument FORWARD-LOOKING. It measures TODAY'S gate on real candidate texts. No resampled verdict is compared against any recorded historical verdict. COMPATIBLE WITH THE RULING, not a departure from it: Path A asks for 'the per-input disagreement rate' on the closed run's CANDIDATES and never required comparing to their recorded verdicts. AND IT SHARPENS THE FIT: the ruling's Q2 says what the existing measurement lacks is 'the live decision-bearing rate -- the rate on real candidate texts produced by the loop in operation, not on frozen synthetic probes or a single repeated candidate.' Real candidate texts examined on the engine any M or W policy would actually operate is exactly that object. It is also the marginal value over D6a, which measured 12% on SYNTHETIC probes. DISSOLVES L2 (submitted-payload) and L6 (instrument drift), both of which bit only on the comparison. REFRAMES L3 from a bias to a sampling frame. DOES NOT DISSOLVE: L4 (the 24-vs-29 set size, still open and still needing production to settle it), L5 (no counterfactual re-election is attempted), L7 (variance is multi-channel), or L3's surviving half (the sample is not representative of a future candidate stream, so no population-level claim follows).
_meta.LIMIT_3_sampling_frame: REFRAMED from a bias to a sampling frame. These texts were selected by their verdict in a past run; forward-looking that states WHICH texts were measured rather than biasing the measurement. Two consequences survive: the sample is NOT representative of a future runner's candidate stream, so no population-level claim follows; and the rejection stratum is ENRICHED for floor-prone texts -- the right population for the floor-borderline question M and W turn on, the wrong one for a general rate. Read strata.
